answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the wander is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra ridge buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The fable is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 6os53.
